desc:
You took this job to pay for your mother's medicine.

Five days as a live-in caregiver for Mbah Lastri, an 87-year-old woman living in an old Dutch colonial house on the slopes of Mount Gelud. No neighbors. No signal. The pay is too good to be true.

Wake Mbah up. Comb her hair. Prepare breakfast. Lock every door at night. The routine is always the same... until one day, it isn't.

- Slow-burn psychological horror rooted in Indonesian folklore
- Play solo or co-op with up to 6 players
- 5 days, each with 3 shifts: morning, afternoon, and night
- 7 endings, with each player experiencing their own fate
- 7 hidden relics to collect
- Progress saves every night
- English and Indonesian subtitles, with Indonesian voice acting

Wear headphones. Turn off the lights.
